sentences.text: The documents do not state that a gold loan has a 5% pre-payment charge.
The in-force bank document shown for pre-payment charges states 2% of principal outstanding, and the copy states 3% of principal outstanding; neither states 5%.
For UCB cases outside para 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, are as per the approved policy of a UCB, and the charge must be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement.
The documents do not state whether this gold loan falls under para 261(1) or (2), or what its approved policy is.

missing.slot: whether this gold loan has a 5% pre-payment charge
missing.searched: searched the loan agreement, the copy agreement, and the UCB Directions on pre-payment charges
